method: The real ZIP payload was CRC-tested, extracted into a new temporary directory, and every extracted file hashed before this report and SHA256SUMS were appended.
final_archive_gate: After appending the two metadata files, the complete final ZIP is CRC-tested and independently extracted again; its included verify_checksums.py must pass for every distributed file. Final ZIP byte hash is recorded outside the ZIP to avoid self-reference.
volume_policy: One complete independent ZIP; no split volumes.
TR_policy: Project asset-scope grading, not archive splitting or a game-validation grade.
